aggregation: Each cohort is reported separately. Prespecified strata are not an IID population estimate. Every selected scene and annotation is verified; no quality filtering.

reconstruction.weighting: Camera/time groups and pairs retain equal statistical weight; angles summarize 0.5-degree pixel-weighted source-view histograms. Repeated surfaces/times are not independent rooms. Primary membership uses the exact X/Z region and roof bounds; this is geometric first-surface visibility, not refracted RGB correspondence.

scope: Current native rendered cohorts. Each sampling population remains separate. Source-image hashes attest the verified local capture run; this compact receipt does not ship every training image. No photographic or downstream-utility claim.
